content: LLM for market reasoning: narratives must be constrained to user-supplied, bar-timestamped data (no model-side market knowledge) to avoid hallucinated levels; use structured output (JSON schema via chat.completions.parse or Anthropic tool-use) with temperature near 0 for reproducibility; cache narratives keyed by setup content hash to control cost; the LLM should be advisory/confirmation (separable component) and never the source of numeric entry/SL/TP - numbers come from the deterministic SMC+ML pipeline; prompt content is local data so injection risk is low but still validate output schema.
